clauses.title: Scope – This standard
clauses.text: 1. Scope - This standard lays down requirements regarding types, sizes, material, construction, workmanship and finish and tests for high density fibre (HDF) panel doors.

clauses.title: Types
clauses.text: 2. Types Door shuttes shall be of following two types: (a)  Heavy Duty -  having void area less than 35 percent, and (b) Light Duty - having void area not exceeding 65 percent

clauses.title: Size
clauses.text: 3. Size

clauses.title: Sizes of the door
clauses.text: 3.1 Sizes of the door shutters shall generally conform to teh sizes given in table 1. Other sizes, that is, width and height, as agreed to between the manufacturer and the purchaser, are also permitted provided they are in modules of 5 mm

clauses.title: The nominal thickness of
clauses.text: 3.2 The nominal thickness of the shuttes shall be 30 mm, 35 mm and 40 mm

clauses.title: Material
clauses.text: 4. Material

clauses.title: Timber
clauses.text: 4.1 Timber

clauses.title: Any species of timber
clauses.text: 4.1.1  Any species of timber having minimum bulk density of 450 kg/m3 at 12 percent moisture content may be used for rails, stiles and core fillings of door shutters. clauses.title: Raised Fibreboard Skin
clauses.text: 4.2  Raised Fibreboard Skin Raised fibre board skin used in door shutters shall be of minimum thickness 3 mm of phenolic bonded high density fibre board conforming to the requirement given in Table 2.

clauses.title: Adhesive
clauses.text: 4.3   Adhesive Adhesive used for bonding the face skins and core shall be phenol formaldehyde synthetic resin adhesive conforming to BWP grade of IS 848. For details on mateirals refer 6 of the standard.

clauses.title: Fittings
clauses.text: 5. Fittings

clauses.title: Locks
clauses.text: 5.1  Locks Shutters shall be shop preapred for taking any suitable type of locks or latches as may be agreed to between the manufacturer and the purchaser. Shop preparing the door with morticed holes for lock fixing shall be done only when desired by the purchaser.

clauses.title: Other
clauses.text: 5.1.1  Other  fittings such as pull bolt, etc, sahll be provided as agreed to beteen teh purchaser and the manufacturer.

clauses.title: Workmanship and finish
clauses.text: 6. Workmanship and finish

clauses.title: All the four edges
clauses.text: 6.1  All the four edges of the door shutter shall be square. The shutter shall be free from twist or warp in its plane.

clauses.title: The surface of the shutter shall be pre
clauses.text: 6.2 The surface of the shutter shall be pre - rimed. The shutter may be supplied either in textured or smooth surface finish as agreed to between the purchaswer and the manufacturer.

clauses.title: Test
clauses.text: 7.  Test

clauses.title: Classification of Tests
clauses.text: 7.1  Classification of Tests

clauses.title: Acceptance Tests
clauses.text: 7.1.1 Acceptance Tests The following tests shall constitute product acceptance (a) Dimension and sqaureness test (b) General flatness test, (c) Local planeness test, (d) End immersion test, (e) Glue adhesion test, and (f) Slamming test

clauses.title: Type Tests
clauses.text: 7.1.2 Type Tests The  following tests shall constitute product approval type tests: (a) Impact indentation test, (b) Flexure test (c) Edge loading test, (e) Shock resistance test: 1) Soft and light body impact test, 2) Soft and heavy body impact test, (f) Misuse test, (g) Screw withdrawal resistance test, and (h) Varying humidity test.
